title: Conormal relations vanish in resolution homology
statement: For A, I and n and a projective resolution P of A/I, specify an augmentation-preserving Koszul chain map a(r,g) to P for every finite tuple g in I. On the free A-module of the actual wedge-cycle generators of [new-e1-koszul-conormal-cycle-presentation], evaluate each generator by the induced homology map of its specified a(r,g). The kernel of the explicit conormal presentation is contained in the kernel of this explicit homology evaluation. No comparison map is an input or conclusion.

source.place: Lemma 23.6.12, strictly commutative Tor product via free Tate resolutions; Tag 00LS, part (2), comparison homotopies

proof.text: Obtain one augmentation-preserving family b and an A-alternating product F on the ideal I with values in the I-annihilated submodule of the quotient-tensored homology of P, satisfying the Koszul wedge formula. This construction precedes conormal descent.

Prove elementary conormal descent in Lean: multilinearity and annihilation by I kill I times the top submodule of I in each slot. Thus F is unchanged when any argument changes by I squared. Use chosen representatives of the proved-surjective toCotangent map; prove independence, additivity, quotient scalar linearity and alternation explicitly, obtaining a quotient-linear alternating map G on I.Cotangent. This includes n=0 because the coordinate arguments are then vacuous. Apply the exterior-power universal property and restrict scalars to obtain d from conormalExteriorModule into resolution homology.

For each wedge-cycle generator compare b(r,g) with the specified a(r,g) by the existing Koszul augmentation-lift homotopy. Tensoring preserves the homotopy, so the homology maps agree. The product normalization and the formula for d on wedges show that d composed with the presentation agrees with evaluation on each single generator. Finsupp linear extensionality and scaling extend this to equality of linear maps. On a presentation-kernel element, rewrite evaluation as d(0)=0.

based_on.place: Lemma 23.6.12, Tate-resolution Tor products; Tag 00LS, Lemma 10.71.4(1), comparison with P

lean.statement: theorem koszulConormalCycleEvaluation_ker (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (P : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) (a : ∀ (r : ℕ) (g : Fin r → I), ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun j ↦ (g j : A)) ⟶ P.complex) (ha : ∀ (r : ℕ) (g : Fin r → I), (a r g).f 0 ≫ P.π.f 0 = ModuleCat.ofHom (I.mkQ.comp (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A)).toLinearMap)) : LinearMap.ker (koszulConormalCyclePresentation A I n) ≤ LinearMap.ker (koszulConormalCycleEvaluation A I n P a)
